name: streamdeck-m365
description: M365 Live — Stream Deck plugin: Next Meeting key (Outlook calendar via Microsoft Graph)

scripts.build: esbuild src/plugin.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=com.sree.m365.sdPlugin/bin/plugin.js "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.pack: npm run build && mkdir -p dist && streamdeck pack com.sree.m365.sdPlugin --output dist --force
